This is the Wujiaochang AKIBA GO in Yangpu District (near Fudan University) — NOT the Nanjing Road AKIBA; coins are not interchangeable between the two. Six maimai deep inside the store (two behind a glass door with a hand-wave sensor switch), plus CHUNITHM, jubeat and more in the back room. Fans above the maimai cabinets; sofa benches and wall outlets for charging. Coins: 30/60/90 CNY packages at 1.00 CNY per coin, WeChat purchase only. Rhythm games and claw machines only. Weekend queue about 10-30 minutes; good player atmosphere. QQ groups: 1007568390 (maimai), 742829700 (local). Transport: Metro Line 10 Wujiaochang Station Exit 1; sunken plaza Exit 4 toward the MUJI building, escalator to 2F rear left.
